0.00302: Export Save and Import Save moved from the title screen into the Settings menu (under Game).
0.00301: The SFX Lab (a testing page): every sound effect where it plays, with or without the scene's music, with volume, pitch and speed to try and approve.
0.00300: Combat: the cards no longer show hover tooltips; an enemy's ⓘ glows when you hover its name.
0.00299: Fixes from the review: the Plague Sister's censer swing always lands (only its smoke can be shrugged off, and never twice), no thrall rises in a cleared room, the knight's starting gear no longer drops as junk for the other classes, the LOOT pop-up tells a beaten find from a worn one and opens with I or from the hero card's inventory page (phones too), SWITCH CLASS drops the boons for real, and the hero screen no longer stacks a stale copy on a resize
Sound and stats housekeeping: a take asked for just before SOUND went off stays silent, the pulled get-hit cries are not downloaded, a failed stats upload keeps the device report for the next
0.00298: A huge tom strikes as you Push Deeper and as the descent from the Great Hall begins.
The room-change whooshes play much louder (they sat where the old quiet swoosh did).
0.00297: New room-change sounds: one of ten whoosh recordings, picked at random, its loudest moment timed to the paintings' crossfade.
The YOU DIED dialog lands with a huge wooden hit, and the Heart's revive rings a spooky metal strike (in the reliquary too).
The coin jingle plays an octave lower.
0.00296: On a computer, Enter the Castle now switches the game to full screen (Esc or the corner icon leaves it).
0.00295: Tap an enemy's name to turn its card over: its level, health, attack, special, immunities and a line of lore
0.00294: The run's end: the five numbers sit on one line and the found items show as larger cards (two rows when you found many).
0.00293: Immunities: the undead and the vermin can shrug off Last Rites' blight and the fire-born the Wizard's Fireball — 'Immune!' instead; the Wizard and the Plague Sister hit a little harder to make up for it
0.00292: Combat: click the LOOT row (bottom left) to see everything you've found this run, with pictures and stats, four at a time with a scroll for more.
0.00291: Your hero's crouching knight look now shows the same inked figure in combat and the Great Hall as in the look picker (the old painted knight is gone).
0.00290: Combat: the inventory side of your hero's card shows each item as a strip with its picture, like the Great Hall's gear slots (this run's finds are no longer listed there).
0.00289: Calmer boss music: the throne room's score is a new, more restrained take (picked in the Music Lab), the menace held under the fight instead of on top of it.
0.00288: The Music Lab has four calmer takes for the boss music to choose from.
